shell.sampleHint: Fictitious company, people, documents and figures
shell.how: What is real and what is simulated?
real: The engine runs the workflow step by step with the sample you pick: it fills {{field}} templates, evaluates conditions, looks up the sample sheets and applies the rules.
Retries with growing waits, and "To review" cases you can retry, approve, mark as handled or discard.
A step's JavaScript code really runs, isolated in your browser.
Add, move, duplicate and delete steps; versions; templates; export the history as CSV and import or export the workflow as JSON.
Everything is saved in this browser (localStorage) until you reset the demo.
sim: The company, its suppliers, customers, invoices and figures are fictitious.
Connectors (email, spreadsheets, accounting software, CRM, payment gateway, WhatsApp) are not connected to anything: nothing is sent or charged.
The "AI" uses fixed rules (XML parsing, keywords and templates); it does not call any model.
Step timings are simulated and waits are shortened.
This month's runs and savings combine a sample pace with what you run here.
tour: Press "Run" with the matching invoice and watch each step on the canvas and in Runs.
Pick invoice FE-10234 (does not match) and run it: the case lands in "To review".
Open "Review cases" and approve or discard the exception.
Change the condition's tolerance or add a step from the palette and run again.
Save a version and try another template (collections or leads).
shell.resetBody: Your workflows, versions, runs and cases are deleted and today's sample data comes back.
shell.resetDone: The demo is back to the sample data.

palette.title: Step palette
palette.hint: Click to add after the selected step, or drag onto the canvas.

trigger_email.name: Incoming email
trigger_email.desc: Fires when an email reaches the mailbox (simulated).
trigger_email.help: Trigger. In the demo, each sample brings an email with the electronic invoice attached (XML). In your project it connects to your real mailbox with read-only access.

trigger_webhook.name: Web form
trigger_webhook.desc: Fires when your site submits a form.
trigger_webhook.help: Trigger. In the demo, the samples are contact forms already submitted. In your project, your site calls a secure workflow address.

trigger_schedule.name: Schedule
trigger_schedule.help: Trigger. Runs at the chosen time and days. In the demo, each sample is one receivables customer checked by that run.

trigger_chat.name: WhatsApp message
trigger_chat.help: Trigger. In the demo the messages are samples and there is no WhatsApp connection. In your project it uses WhatsApp Business with your company's line.

ai_extract.name: Read invoice
ai_extract.desc: Extracts tax ID, number, date, VAT and total from the XML.
ai_extract.help: In the demo the data is read from the XML with fixed rules, and confidence drops if fields are missing, if the tax ID check digit does not match or if subtotal + VAT does not add up to the total. Below the minimum, the case goes to "To review". In your project an AI model does it.

ai_classify.name: Classify message
ai_classify.desc: Assigns a category and detects the city.
ai_classify.help: In the demo it classifies by keywords: one line per category in the format "category: word, word". A category with no words is the fallback. It also detects the city if it appears in the text. In your project an AI model does it.

ai_draft.name: Draft text
ai_draft.desc: Writes a message with the case data.
ai_draft.help: In the demo it fills the template with the data ({{field}}); if a value is missing, the step fails and says which. In your project an AI model writes from this guide.

ai_rag.name: Ask the assistant
ai_rag.desc: Answers with company policies and cites the source.
ai_rag.help: In the demo it looks for the answer by keywords in four sample policies and cites the source; if nothing matches, the case goes to a person. In your project it is KopTup's RAG assistant with your documents.

app_sheet.name: Look up spreadsheet
app_sheet.desc: Finds a row by a column value.
app_sheet.help: Searches one of the three sample sheets (purchase orders, receivables and customers) for the row whose column matches the value. If it is not found, the case goes to "To review".

app_accounting.name: Post to accounting software
app_accounting.desc: Creates the payable or the receipt (simulated).
app_accounting.help: In the demo it validates the party and the amount and generates a sequential document number, but it does not connect to any accounting software. In your project it connects to yours through its API.

app_crm.name: Create CRM contact
app_crm.help: In the demo it checks whether the email already exists in the customers sheet (then it updates it) and assigns an ID; it does not connect to any CRM.

app_payment.name: Create payment link
app_payment.desc: Generates a payment link with a due date (simulated).
app_payment.help: In the demo the link is a sample (pagos.example) and charges nothing. In your project it connects to the payment gateway you use.

app_http.name: HTTP call
app_http.help: In the demo it does not go out to the internet: it validates the address and the JSON and replies with an echo of what you would send.

notify_chat.name: Send message
notify_chat.desc: Via WhatsApp or the team chat (simulated).
notify_chat.help: In the demo nothing is sent: it shows the message with the data filled in. WhatsApp requires a valid Colombian mobile number (10 digits starting with 3).

notify_email.name: Send email
notify_email.desc: Email to the customer or the team (simulated).
notify_email.help: In the demo no email is sent: it validates the address and shows the final text.

logic_condition.name: Condition (if / else)
logic_condition.desc: Compares two values and picks the path.
logic_condition.help: Compares the value with the one in "Against". "Is approximately equal to" accepts the % difference set in the tolerance. If it fails, the case goes to "To review" or the workflow ends without doing anything else.

logic_wait.name: Wait
logic_wait.desc: Pauses the workflow for some minutes.
logic_wait.help: In your project the workflow pauses for the given minutes. In the demo the wait is logged but skipped, so you are not kept waiting.

logic_assign.name: Assign by rule
logic_assign.desc: Picks an owner from a table.
logic_assign.help: One line per rule in the format "value = owner". The "* = …" line is the default rule. Case and accents are ignored.

code_js.name: JavaScript code
code_js.desc: Computes something with your own code.
code_js.help: The code really runs in your browser, isolated (no access to the page or the internet) with a 1.5-second limit. It receives "datos" and whatever you return goes to the next step.

code_map.name: Map fields
code_map.desc: Builds a new object from the data.
code_map.help: One line per field in the format "name = {{field}}". Use it to shape the data the way another system expects.

templates.title: Process templates

desc.invoices: Reads the electronic invoice that arrives by email, compares it with the purchase order and posts it as an account payable. If it does not match, it goes to review.
desc.collections: Every morning it checks receivables, creates a payment link and sends a WhatsApp reminder to customers with overdue invoices.

included.subtitle: What this demo really does. Click for details.
included.future: In your project we also build connectors (Google Drive, SharePoint), the WhatsApp channel, role-based permissions and the metrics dashboard, depending on the plan.

ingest.title: Document loading
ingest.summary: Text, PDF, DOCX, TXT and web pages, depending on the demo mode.
items: Here: with the first question, the fictitious company’s documents are sent as text to the server, which indexes them once and reuses that index for every visitor.
“Try it with your document”: PDF (with page numbers), DOCX and TXT up to 5 MB and 30 pages.
“Build your own”: TXT, MD, CSV, PDF or DOCX up to 2 MB, and public web pages, for your bot.

chunking.title: Chunking
chunking.summary: Each document is split by paragraphs.
items: Paragraphs of up to about 800 characters become one fragment.
Longer paragraphs are split by sentences into blocks of about 500 characters.
Each fragment keeps the document name so it can be cited.

search.title: Keyword search (BM25)
items: Compares the words in your question with each fragment (BM25: word frequency weighted by how rare the word is).
Only the 5 best-scoring fragments are sent to the model.
It is lexical search: use words that appear in the documents. Semantic search (embeddings) is configured in your project.

answer.title: Answers with citations
items: The server always adds three rules for the model: answer only from the fragments, cite the source of each fact and say “I couldn’t find that information in the uploaded documents.” when it is not there.
Each citation [n] opens the exact fragment and the document it came from.

models.title: OpenAI models
models.summary: GPT-4o mini, GPT-4o or GPT-4 Turbo.
items: You pick the model above; the server only accepts these three.
Without an API key, the demo switches to extractive mode: it shows the retrieved fragments with their citation, without writing an answer.

widget.title: Widget for your site
widget.summary: Floating button or iframe with your bot.
items: In “Build your own” you save your bot and copy the code: a script (floating button with the chat) or an iframe.
The embedded chat talks to the same server and shows the citations.

history.title: Conversation history
history.summary: Questions, answers and sources of your bot.
items: In “Build your own” you see what people ask your bot on the direct link or through the widget on your site, how many questions had a source and how many were not found.
You can export them to CSV or delete them. Each saved question is deleted automatically after 30 days.
Questions in “Try the assistant” and in the “Build your own” preview are not saved.

meta.title: AI code review demo: pull request review
meta.description: Interactive demo with sample data: six pull requests from a fictitious fintech with AI comments written in advance, security findings, suggested tests and a simulation of how they reach GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket or Azure DevOps. Includes a rules analyzer that reviews your diff in the browser, without AI.

header.subtitle: Automated pull request (PR) review at {company}, a fictional fintech: risk and score, AI comments on each diff line, security, suggested tests and how it all reaches your repository. The AI comments are written in advance for this demo.

header.audience: For tech leads, CTOs and development teams: a first review within minutes on every PR, in your language and with your team rules.
header.start: Where to start: follow the first steps below. PR #218 is already open with 4 AI comments.
header.quote: Get a quote for your team

meta.title: AI CRM: sales pipeline and forecast demo
meta.description: Interactive demo of a CRM for sales teams in Colombia, with sample data: drag-and-drop pipeline, an explained score for each contact, forecast in Colombian pesos against the target, follow-up sequences and email and WhatsApp drafts built from templates that you can improve with an AI model.

demoCrm.pageSubtitle: Who to call today, what to say and how much you will bill: sales pipeline, a score for each contact, forecast in pesos and WhatsApp and email drafts. Create, move and close deals; everything recalculates instantly.
demoCrm.sampleBadgeHint: This is the CRM of a fictitious logistics company (Logística Quindara S.A.S.). Companies, people, tax IDs (NIT), emails, phone numbers and figures are made up.

howItWorks.title: What is real in this demo
howItWorks.real: Everything is calculated in your browser from the sample data: each contact's score, win probability, metrics, forecast and alerts. You can create, move, edit and delete deals, export contacts to CSV and download the quote as a PDF; your changes are saved only in this browser.
howItWorks.dates: The cut-off date is today (Colombia time). If you come back another day, the dates of the data and of what you logged shift so that "yesterday", "3 days ago" and the forecast period still make sense.
howItWorks.simulated: WhatsApp and email sending, sequence steps and call analysis are simulated: no message is sent and nothing is recorded. The score comes from rules and the drafts from templates. The only call to an AI model is "Improve with AI" in the assistant: it sends the draft to the KopTup server and returns a new wording (with a usage quota).
howItWorks.project: In your project, scores and drafts are generated by an AI model trained on your sales history, and the CRM connects to your WhatsApp Business, email and phone system.

howItWorks.title: How this demo audits
howItWorks.intro: This is exactly what the demo engine does with each invoice. Everything else is configured in your project.

s1.title: PDF reading
s1.desc: The server extracts the PDF text. Scanned PDFs (images) are not read in this demo.

s2.title: AI extraction
s2.desc: The procedures table is read with patterns (code, description, quantity and amounts). An OpenAI language model (GPT-4o mini) extracts the invoice number, patient, ICD-10 diagnosis and authorization.

s3.title: Fee schedule and rules
s3.desc: Each CUPS code is compared against the sample fee schedule. If the billed amount exceeds the tariff, a denial for the difference is proposed.

s4.title: Model proposal
s4.desc: A second OpenAI model (GPT-4o) reviews the data and drafts a proposal: amount to pay, rationale and whether human review is needed.

s5.title: Auditor decision
s5.desc: You confirm, adjust or discard each denial with a note. The server saves each decision and recalculates the totals; once you decide them all, the invoice becomes “With denials” (or “Accepted” if you discarded them all). You can download the report as CSV or PDF.

howItWorks.tariffNote: Sample codes and amounts used by the demo engine. They do not correspond to any real contract or fee schedule manual.

rules.r1: Billed amount above the sample tariff: denial for the difference times the quantity (rule 202, tariff difference).
rules.r2: Code not in the sample fee schedule: the engine proposes denying 30% of the amount. It is a provisional demo rule; in your project it is replaced by your contract's tariffs.
rules.r3: Rule codes (such as 202) are internal to this demo and do not match those of the “Auditor's rules engine” demo, whose rules are not applied here. In your project they are mapped to Colombia's current Single Manual of Returns, Denials and Responses.

howItWorks.notIncludedTitle: What this demo does not do (built in your project)

notIncluded.n1: Read RIPS files (JSON or Excel) and cross-check them with the PDF.
notIncluded.n2: Validate authorizations with the payer (validity and quantities).
notIncluded.n3: Review clinical consistency between diagnosis and procedure, and medications.
notIncluded.n5: Take the provider and payer from the PDF: the demo uses a sample provider and payer.
notIncluded.n6: Apply per-payer contracts and official catalogs (CUPS, ICD-10) with their version.
notIncluded.n8: Keep data separate per client: this demo space is shared.

a.forecastNoGoal: At the current pace, {from} – {to} would close at {value} (80% range: {low} to {high}).

how.margin: Margin = (sales − cost) ÷ sales, by line, comparing the period with the same months of {prevYear}. Lines are sorted from the largest drop to the largest increase.
how.customersDown: For each customer I compare the period’s sales with the same months of {prevYear} (only customers who were already buying) and sort by the difference in pesos.
how.cash8: This is week 8 of the 13-week cash flow in Finance: it starts from cash at cut-off ({date}: {start}) and adds projected collections and subtracts payments week by week.
how.cityGoal: Target for each city or site = its sales in the same months of {prevYear} + {goal}%. Attainment = sales ÷ target.
how.overdue: I add up open invoices more than 60 days past due at the end of the period and group them by customer.
how.forecastSeasonal: Each month = sales of the same month last year × growth of the last 3 months vs. the same months last year ({growth}). The 80% band comes from the error this method had in the months already known (deviation {sigma}).
how.forecastTrend: Linear trend of the last months with data. The 80% band comes from the deviation from that trend ({sigma}).

intro.title: Executive dashboard for management
intro.subtitle: Sales against target, margin, receivables, cash flow and alerts for a Colombian company on one screen, with a PDF report ready for the board.

how.title: How this demo works
how.data: Every figure comes from the same sample invoices and is calculated in your browser: what you see in Overview, Finance, Customers, the alerts and the PDF always adds up.
how.dates: The cut-off is the last closed month ({month}); you can review any of the last 12 months, their quarters or the year to date.
how.noAi: No AI in this demo: the summary and alerts are built with rules, the projection is statistical and the questions are guided. In your project, an AI model can write the summary and answer free-form questions.
how.simulated: The Monday summary is a preview: nothing is sent automatically. Connectors (Siigo, SAP Business One, HubSpot and others) are set up in your project; there are no connections here.
how.storage: Your settings are saved only in this browser. Any CSV you load never leaves it and is discarded when you reload.

header.audience: For restaurants, chains and stores with their own delivery that depend on aggregator apps today. Start with the suggested walkthrough: place an order as a customer and follow it to delivery.
header.quote: Get a quote for your delivery app
header.howTitle: What is real and what is simulated

how.real: Real in your browser: the order goes through the 4 apps with a single shared state; prices, distance-based delivery fee, tip, points, KPIs, stage times, avoided commission and the CSV are calculated from the orders.
how.rules: Rules, not AI: the courier suggestion (closest and free), the stop order and the review of suspicious orders.
how.clock: Demo clock: the sample day is today and starts at 7:05 PM; it runs in real time and jumps ahead when the kitchen finishes, the courier reaches the store or delivers, so the times are realistic.
how.simulated: Simulated: payments (always approved unless you turn on the test decline), WhatsApp, masked call, GPS, map and courier position. In your project they connect to the payment gateway, WhatsApp Business, a telephony provider and a maps service.
how.storage: What you do is saved only in this browser; “Reset demo” goes back to the sample data.

how.title: What is real and what is simulated in this demo
real: What you do is saved in your browser and survives a reload; “Reset demo” goes back to the sample data.
The indicators are computed from the envelope list: they change when you send, sign or void, or when an envelope expires.
The SHA-256 fingerprint of the PDF you upload or of the template text is computed in your browser; the file never leaves your device.
Every step adds an event to the evidence, chained with SHA-256 hashes; “Verify integrity” recomputes the chain.
The CSV files, the envelope JSON and the sample PDFs (evidence certificate and signed document) are really generated and downloaded.
The signature is drawn with the mouse or a finger, typed or uploaded as an image, and it goes into the PDF.
sim: No email, SMS or WhatsApp message is sent: the verification code is shown on screen.
Identity verification with ID and selfie, digital signature with a certificate and the timestamp from a digital certification authority (ECD) are simulated.
The IP addresses in the evidence are samples (ranges reserved for documentation).
The company, people, emails (.example) and documents are fictitious; the template texts were not reviewed by a lawyer.
Integrations and the API are built in your project; here they are only described.
tour: In “Home”, look at the indicators and the envelope list, and open the evidence of the completed employment contract.
Click “New envelope”, choose the “Fixed-term employment contract” template and change the worker’s name.
Check the signers and the order, place the fields by tapping the page and send the envelope.
In “Signer view”, open the document, request the code, type it, sign with your finger or mouse and accept.
In “Evidence”, verify the hash chain and download the PDF certificate.

how.title: What is real and what is simulated
real: Sample data: favorites, rename, move to a folder, create folders, trash, restore, delete permanently and reset. Saved in your browser.
Search in each document's name, tags and text, showing the matching snippet; filters by type, date and tag; sorting.
Rule-based clause detection with a risk level on the open contract's text; word-by-word comparison between versions.
Retention by folder: the keep-until date of each document is calculated, and legal hold blocks the trash.
Downloads generated in your browser: CSV inventory, audit package (CSV or JSON) and a watermarked PDF copy.
My documents (signed in): upload PDF, DOCX, TXT and CSV, AI summary and tags, search by meaning, “Explain with AI” and “Why this result?” on the server, with an AI spending cap.
sim: The construction company's 16 documents are fictitious; their summaries, keywords and explanations are written in advance (not generated live by AI).
The OCR reading of the scanned invoices is sample data: this demo does not process any image.
With sample data, “Search by meaning” widens the search with synonyms in your browser; it does not use AI.
Retention periods are illustrative and the rule only applies in this demo, not on the server.
tour: Search for “cláusula penal” (the documents are in Spanish) and look at the highlighted snippet on each card.
Open the works contract: click “Detect clauses” and then “Compare versions”.
Open a scanned invoice and click “View OCR reading”.
Turn on legal hold for “Contracts” (archive icon next to Folders) and try to move a contract to the trash.
Export the inventory or build an audit package; to upload your documents, go to “My documents”.
how.buildTitle: What we build in your project
build: Real OCR for scanned documents and reading of electronic invoices.
Intake by email, phone, Google Drive or SharePoint, and through an API.
Folder permissions, access auditing and your company's records retention schedule (TRD).
Connection to your RAG assistant to ask your documents questions and get answers with the source.

meta.description: Interactive service desk demo for Colombia with sample data: one ticket inbox for email, web chat, WhatsApp, Messenger, Telegram and calls; automatic classification and assignment, AI reply drafts grounded in your knowledge base, SLAs, macros, CSAT/NPS and PQRS tracked in business days.

demoHelpdesk.pageSubtitle: For customer service teams at online stores, internet providers, credit unions and service companies. All your channels in one inbox: tickets are classified and assigned automatically, AI drafts the reply from your knowledge base, and you track SLAs and PQRS (petitions, complaints and claims) in business days.

howItWorks.title: What is real in this demo
howItWorks.real: Everything runs in your browser with the sample data: filters, search, classification, assignment by skill and workload, macros, SLAs with escalation, PQRS with business days and Colombian public holidays, surveys, metrics and CSV export. Your changes are saved only in this browser.
howItWorks.ai: “Draft with AI” really calls an AI model from our server and answers only with the articles of this demo’s knowledge base, citing the source. If the server has no AI key configured, it shows you the most relevant excerpts and tells you so.
howItWorks.simulated: Channels and sending are simulated: no message or survey is actually sent. Classification, confidence and auto-reply use keyword rules, not an AI model.
howItWorks.project: In your project we connect your real channels (for example, WhatsApp Business and your email), load your knowledge base and, if you need it, classify tickets with an AI model trained on your own tickets.

kb.useDisabled: Select an open ticket to use the article

refund.title: How to process a refund or a duplicate charge
refund.body: Check in the payment gateway that there are two approved transactions. If the charge is duplicated, request the reversal from the payments panel: the money returns to the payment method in 3 to 8 business days, depending on the bank. Record the request number in the ticket and let the customer know.
refund.reply: Hi {name}, we confirmed the duplicate charge and have already requested the refund. The money returns to your payment method in 3 to 8 business days, depending on your bank. We’ll email you the receipt.

einvoice.title: I didn’t receive my electronic invoice
einvoice.body: The electronic invoice is emailed to the registered address when it is issued. If it doesn’t arrive, check the spam folder and confirm the registered email is correct. The PDF and XML can be downloaded from “My invoices” at any time. If the email is wrong, update it and resend the invoice.
einvoice.reply: Hi {name}, your electronic invoice is sent to the email address you registered, so please also check your spam folder. You can download the PDF and XML from “My invoices” anytime. If you prefer, we can resend it to another email.

pse.title: Pending or declined PSE payments
pse.body: A PSE payment can stay pending for up to 30 minutes while the bank confirms it. If the bank declines it, no money is debited. If the customer sees the debit and the payment shows as declined, the bank reverses the money automatically in 1 to 3 business days.
pse.reply: Hi {name}, a PSE payment can stay pending for up to 30 minutes while your bank confirms it. If the bank declined it and you see the debit, the reversal is automatic within 1 to 3 business days. If it doesn’t show up, write to us with the receipt.

password.title: Reset your password or access code
password.body: On the sign-in screen choose “Forgot your password?”. A link is sent to the registered email, valid for 15 minutes. If the SMS verification code doesn’t arrive, check the signal and that the registered number is correct; a new code can be requested every 60 seconds.
password.reply: Hi {name}, on the sign-in screen choose “Forgot your password?” and you’ll get a link by email, valid for 15 minutes. If the SMS code doesn’t arrive, you can request a new one every 60 seconds. If it still doesn’t work, reply here and we’ll help you.

orderStatus.title: Order status and tracking number
orderStatus.body: The tracking number is emailed when the order leaves the warehouse and also appears in “My orders”. Shipping to major cities takes 2 to 4 business days, and to other towns 4 to 7 business days.
orderStatus.reply: Hi {name}, you can check your order status under “My orders” with your tracking number, which is also emailed to you when the order leaves the warehouse. Shipping to major cities takes 2 to 4 business days. If it doesn’t arrive within that time, reply here and we’ll look into it.

address.title: Change the delivery address
address.body: The address can be changed as long as the order has not left the warehouse. Confirm the full new address (neighborhood, apartment and city) and update it on the order. If it has already shipped, request the change from the carrier, which may charge a fee.
address.reply: Hi {name}, we can change the address as long as your order hasn’t left the warehouse. Send us the full address (neighborhood, apartment and city) and we’ll update it right away.

returns.title: Exchanges and returns
returns.body: For online purchases, customers have a right of withdrawal within 5 business days after delivery (Colombian Consumer Statute, Law 1480 of 2011). Size exchanges are requested in “My orders” within 30 days after delivery, with the item unused and with its tags.
returns.reply: Hi {name}, you can request the exchange in “My orders” within 30 days after delivery, with the item unused and with its tags. If you’d rather return it, you have a right of withdrawal within 5 business days after delivery.

slowInternet.title: Slow or intermittent internet: troubleshooting
slowInternet.body: Before escalating: 1) check whether there is a reported outage in the area; 2) ask the customer to unplug the modem for 30 seconds; 3) test the speed over a cable; 4) check how many devices are connected. If the internet light is still red, escalate to level 2 support.
slowInternet.reply: Hi {name}, let’s check it together: unplug the modem for 30 seconds and plug it back in. If the internet light is still red, let us know and we’ll escalate the case to technical support right away.

visit.title: Schedule or reschedule a technician visit
visit.body: Technician visits are scheduled in a morning slot (8:00 to 12:00) or an afternoon slot (14:00 to 18:00), Monday to Saturday. The technician confirms by WhatsApp one hour before. If the visit doesn’t happen because of the company, it is not charged.
visit.reply: Hi {name}, we can schedule the visit in the morning slot (8:00 to 12:00) or the afternoon slot (14:00 to 18:00), Monday to Saturday. The technician will confirm by WhatsApp one hour before. Which slot works for you?

cancelPlan.title: Cancel or pause a plan
cancelPlan.body: Before cancelling, offer an alternative: switching to a cheaper plan or pausing the service for up to 2 months. If the customer insists, file the cancellation request; it takes effect at the end of the billing cycle.
cancelPlan.reply: Hi {name}, before cancelling, we can move you to a cheaper plan or pause the service for up to 2 months at no cost. If you prefer to cancel, we’ll file your request and it will take effect at the end of your billing cycle.

t1.subject: I was charged twice through PSE
t1.m1: Hi, yesterday I paid for my order #MA-20931 through PSE and my bank statement shows two charges of COP 189,900. Please refund one of them.
t1.m3: Hi Lucía, I’m sorry for the trouble. I’m already checking the two charges on your order #MA-20931 with the payments team.
t1.m4: Thanks. How long will it take to get my money back? This is the third time this has happened and I’m fed up.
t1.n1: Frequent customer. The payment gateway shows two approved transactions 40 seconds apart.

t2.subject: No internet since last night
t2.m1: (Call transcript) I’ve had no internet since last night. I already restarted the modem three times and the internet light is still red. I work from home and this is unacceptable.
t2.m2: Javier, I checked your service: there’s a reported outage in your area. Your case is logged and I’ll let you know as soon as we have an estimated fix time.
t2.n1: Area-wide outage at the Villavicencio Centro node. Network incident open with level 2 support.

t3.subject: I want to cancel my TV plan
t3.m1: Good morning. I want to cancel my TV plan because I hardly use it. What do I need to do?
t3.m3: Hi Marta, we filed your request under number PQRS-2026-0418. Before you cancel, I can move you to the internet-only plan, which lowers your bill without changing your speed. Shall I send you the comparison?

t4.subject: Change the delivery address for order #MA-21055
t4.m1: Hi, I just placed order #MA-21055 and got the address wrong. It’s Carrera 45 # 12-30, apartment 502. Can you change it before it ships?

t5.subject: Thanks for the great service
t5.m1: I just wanted to thank Ana: she helped me exchange a size in minutes. Excellent service!
t5.m2: Thank you, Sofía! We’re so glad. We’re here for whatever you need.

t6.subject: My electronic invoice didn’t arrive
t6.m1: Good morning. This month my electronic invoice for the internet service never reached my email, and I need it for my business accounting.
t6.n1: First-reply SLA breached: priority went from Medium to High and the shift supervisor was notified (simulated notice).

t7.subject: Can’t sign in to their account
t7.m1: Hi, I'm trying to log in to my account to check my order, but it says my password is wrong. I already tried twice. Can you help me, please?

t8.subject: Refund pending for three weeks
t8.m1: I returned a jacket on September 14 and was told the COP 249,900 refund would arrive within 5 business days. It’s been three weeks and nobody answers me. If I don’t get a solution today, I’ll file a complaint with the SIC.

t9.subject: Where is my order #MA-20877?
t9.m1: Hi, can you tell me where my order #MA-20877 is? I bought it on Monday and I still don’t have the shipping tracking number.
t9.m2: Hi Valentina, you can check your order status under “My orders” with your tracking number, which is also emailed to you when the order leaves the warehouse. Shipping to major cities takes 2 to 4 business days. If it doesn’t arrive within that time, reply here and we’ll look into it.

t10.subject: Claim for a charged technician visit that never happened
t10.m1: I was charged COP 80,000 for a technician visit that never happened: nobody came on September 18. I’m asking you to credit that amount on my next invoice.
t10.m2: Hi Hernán, we filed your claim under number PQRS-2026-0402. We’re checking the visit order with the technical team and will reply within the legal term.
t10.m3: Any news? It’s been more than ten days.
t10.n1: The technician reported “customer not home”, but there’s no photo or signature of the visit. I suggest crediting the COP 80,000 on the October bill.

t11.subject: Not getting the code to sign in to the app
t11.m1: Hi, I’m trying to get into the cooperative’s app and the SMS verification code never arrives. I already checked that my number is correct.

t12.subject: Request for a certificate of contributions and loan status
t12.m1: Good afternoon. I need a certificate of my contributions and my loan status to present at the bank. How do I request it?
t12.m2: Hi Andrés, we filed your petition under number PQRS-2026-0410. The collections department issues the certificate and we’ll send it to your registered email.

surveys.s1: Ana solved my size exchange in minutes.
surveys.s5: The technician arrived two hours late.
surveys.s9: They refunded the duplicate charge the same day.

pse.label: Double PSE charge
pse.text: Hi, I paid for my purchase through PSE and COP 159,900 was taken from my account twice. Can you refund the duplicate charge? I’m really annoyed.

tracking.label: Where is my order?

sic.label: Complaint mentioning the SIC

meta.title: HR and Payroll
meta.subtitle: Employee records, vacation and leave, recruiting, onboarding and offboarding, performance, Colombian semi-monthly payroll and training, with an employee app and an AI policy assistant.
meta.sampleHint: Alimentos Valdeora S.A.S. is a fictitious company: people, tax ID, providers and figures are made up.
meta.seoDescription: Interactive demo with sample data: digital employee records, vacation in business days with Colombian holidays, recruiting with a rule-based fit score, onboarding and offboarding with final settlement, performance reviews, semi-monthly payroll with contributions and accruals, simulated electronic payroll and social security filing, and an AI policy assistant.
meta.audience: For HR managers, payroll leads and owners of small and mid-sized companies with operational staff. Everything runs in your browser with sample data from a fictitious company; only the policy assistant uses real AI.
meta.quote: Get a quote for this system

header.resetBody: This deletes the changes you made in this browser (requests, hires, payroll, reviews) and regenerates the data with today's date.

guide.title: Suggested walkthrough: the full cycle in 5 steps
guide.subtitle: You act as HR and as the direct manager; the employee app shows Camila Rojas Parra, a packer in Funza. Each step is checked off when you do it.

request.title: Request vacation from the app
request.text: As Camila, pick the start date and business days; the app works out the return date with Colombian holidays.

approve.title: Approve it as HR
approve.text: In Vacation and leave, approve or reject the request and see the balance change.

hire.title: Hire a candidate
hire.text: In Recruiting, move someone from Offer to Hired and complete their onboarding checklist.

pay.title: Calculate and pay the period
pay.text: In Payroll: add a change, calculate, approve and pay (downloads the payment file).

assistant.title: Ask the assistant
assistant.text: In the app, check the payslip and ask about the internal rules (real AI with sources).

guide.finished: You went through the full cycle. Want to see it with your company's positions, sites and rules?
guide.finishedQuote: Get a quote for this system

footer.sample: Sample data: Alimentos Valdeora S.A.S., its employees, the candidates, health providers, pension funds, family benefit funds, the occupational risk insurer and the banks are fictitious. Payroll parameters (minimum wage, transport allowance, UVT, working hours and surcharges) are 2026 sample values: in your project they are configured and validated with your labor and accounting advisors.
footer.integrations: Electronic payroll submission to the DIAN, the social security filing, the bank payment file, the electronic contract signature and the delivery of surveys and reminders are simulated in the demo; in your project they connect to your electronic payroll provider, your social security operator, your bank and your communication channels. The policy assistant does use real AI from our server.

overview.scopeTitle: What this demo does and does not do

does.0: Generates the post, ad copy and a carousel with AI (an OpenAI model called from KopTup's server, with a usage quota) or, when AI is not available, with local templates, and tells you which one it used.
does.1: Lets you edit the text, checks it for accuracy alerts, saves drafts in this browser and exports them to CSV.
does.2: Creates 1200×627 images from templates, downloads the carousel as a PDF and takes a photo or video of the KopTup demos you can open.
does.3: Adds UTM parameters to links so you can measure visits in your analytics.

doesNot.0: It does not connect to your LinkedIn account or post for you. In a custom project it can connect to the LinkedIn API if your company has approved access.
doesNot.1: It does not measure reach, clicks or followers: the preview shows no real reactions.
doesNot.2: It does not make up results: the texts include no client figures or testimonials; if you add a figure, it needs a source.

howItWorks.title: What is real and what is simulated in this demo
howItWorks.real: Calculated for real in your browser: the points for each purchase (base rule plus multipliers by category, day and channel), the balance as the sum of the points ledger, tiers, redemptions with coupons and checkout discounts, missions, referrals, fraud rules, allowed campaign hours (including Colombian public holidays), the cost simulator, the points liability and the CSV export.
howItWorks.simulated: Simulated: sending WhatsApp, email or SMS (you see the preview, no message is sent), the Apple Wallet and Google Wallet pass (preview), sweepstakes, and the figures for the 29,200-member base (KPIs, cohorts, mission results, A/B tests and partners). Segments come from rules: there is no AI model in this demo. The WhatsApp and email buttons in “Invite friends” do open your app with the message ready.
howItWorks.project: In your project, the checkout connects to your POS or online store through an API, points live in a points ledger in your database, messages go out through WhatsApp Business with approved templates, the pass is issued for Apple Wallet and Google Wallet with your brand, and reports come from your real data.
howItWorks.dates: The demo works with today's date in Colombia: sample purchases, expirations and reports are built backwards from today, and what you record gets Colombia's date and time. Your changes are saved only in this browser.

how.title: How this demo works
real: Each case's classification: a rule-based classifier reads the text (or the sample description or transcript) and computes the category, the confidence and the fragments that explain it.
Threshold rules: you decide what happens based on confidence; the queue shows where each case would go and «Apply rules to the queue» resolves the automatic ones.
Approve, reject (with policy and measure), escalate (to a team) and correct the category: every decision goes to the audit log and changes the figures.
Appeals with a deadline that runs on real time, an audit log you can export to CSV and a sample transparency report in PDF.
Wellbeing: blur by default, a break that hides the queue, a check-in and rotation away from sensitive categories.
«Explain with AI»: an AI model on our server reads the content and the platform policy and cites the section that applies.
sim: The platform, users and cases are fictional; insults, groups and contact details are masked.
For images, video and audio there are no real files: a sample description or transcript is classified.
The transparency report figures and the simulator's batch of 240 items are sample data.
Escalating, warning or suspending notifies no one: it is recorded in the demo.
The integration examples are illustrative: there is no public moderation API.
tour: In «Moderation queue» open the off-platform payment case (c-2041) and look at the highlighted reasons and the policy that applies.
Reject a case choosing a policy and a measure, and find it in «Audit».
In «Rules» activate rule 8 (illegal lending), save and see how the simulator and the route of case c-2043 change.
Press «Apply rules to the queue» so the rules resolve the automatic cases.
In «Classification» paste your own text, send it to the queue and ask «Explain with AI».
how.project: In your project we connect your platform, load your policies, use a moderation model or an LLM with your examples and measure accuracy with your data before committing to figures.

meta.description: Point-of-sale demo with sample data from Colombia: sell with a barcode scanner and a scale or by table with kitchen tickets, take split payments, issue a sample electronic POS document, simulate selling offline and close the till with X and Z reports. Includes a multi-store console with inventory and transfers. Everything runs in your browser.

header.kicker: Interactive demo · For stores, grocery stores and restaurants

demoPos.pageSubtitle: For owners and managers of grocery stores, shops and restaurants with one or more locations. Sell with a barcode scanner and a scale or by table with kitchen tickets, take split payments, issue a sample electronic POS document and close the till with X and Z reports. howItWorks.title: What is real in this demo
howItWorks.real: Everything is calculated in your browser: stock per store, taxes included in prices (19% VAT, 5% VAT, exempt or 8% consumption tax), points, change, tips, kitchen tickets, X and Z reports, cash count, commissions and the store console. Your sales and changes are saved only in this browser.
howItWorks.scanner: The “Scan” field accepts a real barcode scanner connected as a keyboard (USB or Bluetooth); if you don't have one, use the sample codes.
howItWorks.simulated: Simulated: sending the document to the DIAN (the CUDE is computed here with SHA-384, in test mode, and never leaves your browser), the card terminal, QR payments, the scale, printer and cash drawer, and sending the receipt by WhatsApp or email. The “Offline” button is a demo switch: it does not cut your connection or store anything elsewhere.
howItWorks.project: In your project, the till installs as an app on a tablet or PC, stores sales on the device when the internet goes down and syncs them when it comes back, issues the electronic document through your authorized technology provider and connects to your card terminal, thermal printer, scanner, cash drawer and scale.

101.name: Missing authorization
101.description: The catalog says the service needs prior authorization and the line has none. Denies the line amount.

102.name: Tariff difference
102.description: For services without an agreed price, the unit price exceeds the manual tariff by more than the tolerance. Denies the difference.

201.name: Invalid CUPS code
201.description: The code does not exist in the catalog. Denies the line amount.

202.name: Incomplete or expired authorization
202.description: The authorization lacks a number, date or validity, or the service was provided after it expired. Denies the line amount.

301.name: Clinical inconsistency
301.description: The service does not fit the patient (for example, an obstetric ultrasound billed for a male patient). Flagged for auditor review, with no amount.

303.name: Duplicate services
303.description: The same service is billed more than once for the same patient and date. Denies the repeated line.

401.name: Price above the contract
401.description: For services with an agreed price in the contract, the unit price exceeds it. Denies the difference, with no tolerance.

402.name: Quantity above authorized
402.description: The billed quantity exceeds the authorized one. Denies the extra units.

how.title: How the engine decides
how.subtitle: AI helps to read and to find; denials come from explicit rules your team can review.

steps.s1Text: In your project, AI extracts the provider, patient, diagnoses and every service with its code, quantity and price from the invoice and its supporting documents. In this demo the sample batch is already structured.
steps.s2Text: Each code is looked up in the CUPS catalog and the reference tariff is computed from the manual or the agreed price in the contract.
steps.s3Text: Each rule is a condition you can read and test: authorization, tariff, quantities, duplicates and basic consistency. AI never decides a denial.
steps.s4Text: Each proposed denial shows the rule, the compared values and the denied amount, as you can see in the simulator.
steps.s5Text: In your project, the auditor accepts, adjusts or discards each denial before sending it to the provider.

how.aiTitle: What AI does and does not do
how.ai1: Does: extract data from documents (in your project) and search codes by meaning with semantic vectors (on the server, when its catalog has vectorized codes).
how.ai2: Does not: decide denials. Rules are explicit, auditable conditions.
how.ai3: Does not: file or send denials without human review.

meta.title: Booking system: interactive demo
meta.description: Booking system demo with sample data from Colombia: availability by professional and location with public holidays, 5-step booking with a simulated deposit, business calendar by day and week, metrics, simulated WhatsApp reminders and .ics and CSV export.

shell.subtitle: How your customers book and how you see your calendar: availability calculated by professional and location, online deposit and WhatsApp reminders (simulated), plus the business calendar and metrics.

how.title: How this demo works and what is simulated
real: Availability is calculated from each professional's or pitch's schedule, the service length plus preparation time, Colombian public holidays and existing bookings: appointments never overlap.
Your booking shows up in the business calendar, where you can confirm it, reschedule it, mark whether the customer showed up, cancel it, delete it and save notes.
Metrics (occupancy, no-shows, revenue, deposits, services and channels) are recalculated with every change.
Real downloads: the appointment or the calendar as an .ics file for Google Calendar, Outlook or Apple Calendar, and the booking list as CSV.
Your changes are saved in this browser for 7 days; «Reset data» goes back to the initial sample.
sim: Payments: the deposit with PSE, Nequi or card is a simulation; nothing is charged and no card details are requested. In your project it connects to the payment gateway you choose.
Messages: WhatsApp and email confirmations and reminders are previews; nothing is sent. In your project they connect to WhatsApp Business Platform and to your email.
Automatic sync with each professional's calendar (Google Calendar or Outlook) is set up during implementation; here you export and import the .ics file.
tour: Customer view: choose a location and a service; the calendar shows public holidays and fully booked days.
Pick a professional, date and time among the free slots (also try the Week view).
Fill in your details, accept the personal data authorization and pay the simulated deposit.
On the confirmation, download the .ics and simulate the reminder with the «Confirm» or «Reschedule» buttons.
Switch to Business view: your appointment is highlighted in the calendar; mark a past appointment as «No-show» and watch the metrics change.

route.title: First steps: suggested walkthrough (about 5 minutes)
route.s1: As a patient, describe your symptoms: if there are no red flags, it suggests the specialty to book.
route.s2: Book an appointment for today with that specialty (the WhatsApp confirmation is simulated).
route.s3: With today's appointment, fill in the pre-visit form and consents: the patient joins the waiting room.
route.s4: As the clinician, refer María González (red flag) and call a patient, for example the one you just checked in.
route.s5: Record the diagnosis, sign the prescription and orders, and finish: the summary and invoice are created.
route.intro: Each step takes you to its tab and checks itself off when you do it. This is how a telehealth visit flows end to end.
route.s6: Collect the patient's share with the simulated gateway and review the visit's invoice and RIPS.

a1.title: Payment agreements: conditions
a1.body: An installment can be split into 2 payments within the same month, with no late interest if the dates are met.

a2.title: Contact hours for collections
a2.body: Only call Monday to Friday 7:00 to 19:00 and Saturdays 8:00 to 15:00; never on Sundays or public holidays. Respect the do-not-call list.

turns.t1: Hi, I’m {agent}, the virtual assistant at {company}. This call is recorded for quality and we process your data under our privacy policy. How can I help?
turns.t2: Hi, I want to know where my order TU-58213 is.
turns.t3: Sure. To confirm you are the account holder, could you tell me the email you used for the purchase?
turns.t5: Thanks, Felipe. Your order TU-58213 left our warehouse in Funza and is out for delivery in Medellín; the carrier expects to deliver it today between 2:00 and 6:00 in the afternoon.
turns.t6: Part of it already arrived and the blender came with a broken jar. I’m pretty upset.
turns.t7: I’m very sorry about the blender. I’ve opened a warranty case and sent you a WhatsApp so you can attach photos. I’ll connect you with a human agent to handle the replacement.
turns.t9: I’m transferring you now to {human}, from customer service. I’ve already shared the call summary so you don’t have to repeat anything.

a1.body: If a product arrives damaged, it is replaced free of charge. Ask for photos of the product and the packaging, and schedule the pickup within 48 business hours.

howItWorks.title: What is real and what is simulated in this demo
howItWorks.script: The four calls follow a fixed script: there is no speech recognition or live AI model, and the intent, confidence and sentiment are precomputed.
howItWorks.voice: Your browser generates the voice with the English voices it has installed; if it has none, the call moves forward with the transcript only.
howItWorks.simulated: The agent’s actions, the handoff, the WhatsApp messages and the payment links are simulated: the demo does not connect to any system or send any message.
howItWorks.real: Computed for real: the campaign rules (contact hours, Colombian public holidays for every year, frequency and do-not-call list), the call log metrics and the files you download.
howItWorks.storage: Your test calls, the personalization and the campaign are stored only in this browser.
howItWorks.project: In your project: a +57 number or your SIP trunk, speech recognition, a language model and a neural voice, connected to your systems.

pick.title: Pick the call and your company
pick.text: Four sample calls: banking, healthcare, collections and orders. Type your company name to hear it in the greeting.

listen.title: Listen to the call
listen.text: Press “Start call”: you will see the transcript, intent and sentiment turn by turn.

result.title: Review the outcome
result.text: When it ends you get the summary, the actions the agent ran and the call in the log.

transfer.title: Try the handoff
transfer.text: In “Order” the agent hands the call to a human agent with full context. You can also transfer it yourself.

campaign.title: Simulate the collections campaign
campaign.text: The dialer blocks Sundays, public holidays, disallowed hours, repeated calls and the do-not-call list.

demoWms.pageSubtitle: Receiving with scanning, rule-based putaway, inventory by lot and expiry, picking waves, packing with a shipping label, own-fleet routing, returns and 3PL pre-invoicing. Everything runs in your browser with a sample operation.

meta.title: WMS and warehouse logistics
meta.seoTitle: WMS demo: receiving, lot inventory, picking and shipping

tour.title: Suggested walkthrough (CEDI Funza)
tour.subtitle: Six steps, about 4 minutes. Each step checks itself off when you do it.

received.title: Receive PO OC-24871
received.text: Simulate the truck unloading (or scan) and close the receipt: the demo detects the shortage.

putaway.title: Put away what you received
putaway.text: Confirm or change the rule-based location (rotation, volume, FEFO).

wave.title: Release a wave
wave.text: Select the orders with stock (or those due today), pick a strategy and release the wave.

picked.title: Pick the wave
picked.text: In the picker view, scan the location and the product at each stop.

shipped.title: Pack and create the label
shipped.text: Verify, weigh, compare carriers and create the shipping label.

delivered.title: Deliver with proof
delivered.text: In the driver app, record the delivery with name, signature and photo.

wave.name: By order (wave)
wave.desc: The wave’s orders are picked one by one: one trip per order. Simplest, but it means the most walking.

batch.name: Batch
batch.desc: A single trip for all the wave’s orders, adding up quantities per location. They are split by order at packing.

zone.name: By zone
zone.desc: Each picker works their zone (A, B or C) at the same time; orders are consolidated at packing.

cluster.name: Cluster
cluster.desc: A cart with up to 6 totes: each tote is an order and the locations of those orders are visited together.

putaway.title: Putaway
putaway.subtitle: Location suggested by simple, explainable rules. You can change it before confirming.
putaway.none: No putaway tasks in this warehouse.
putaway.allDone: Everything received is already put away.

rules.sameSku: There are already lots of this SKU at that location: they are kept together and the picker takes the one that expires first (FEFO).
rules.highRotation: Class A (fast movers): zone A, the closest to the shipping dock.
rules.bulky: Bulky or heavy product: zone C.
rules.reserve: Medium or slow movers: reserve zone B.
rules.overflow: No space in the preferred zone: first free location.
rules.damaged: Damaged units: they go to quarantine until reviewed.

putaway.note: The rules (rotation, volume and expiry) are configured in your project for your warehouse. It is not artificial intelligence: they are rules you can audit.

crossdock.title: Cross-dock
crossdock.subtitle: Goods move from the receiving dock to the shipping dock without being stored.

kits.subtitle: Assemble kits from their components: they are consumed by FEFO and the kit enters inventory with its own lot.
kits.onlyFun: In the sample operation kits are assembled at CEDI Funza.
kits.note: The kit expires when its first-expiring component expires.
